summary: Operator page: 16 RV sites, electric every site + seasonal water/sewer, $40 + tax, non-refundable, no tents, lodge showers/laundry; books on the resort's Windsurfer engine. Imagery shows a real designated RV lot (16 concrete pull-in pads with grass islands) separate from casino parking. Gate passes; Google 4.1 (1,856, the resort). Pin ok. flags: CASINO-LOT TEST: passes. Imagery at 46.2720,-100.6374 shows a dedicated RV lot south of the casino's main parking: 16 diagonal concrete pull-in pads (two rows of 8) separated by grass islands, with RVs on them, off the main parking aisles; the operator page sells them by the night ('$40 per night plus tax') with hookups ('Electric Hookups at every site', 'Seasonal water and sewer hookups'). It is not a parking-lot allowance.

PRIVATE GATES: price $40 + tax (operator page, current 2026) under $50; presence: operator website + phone (701) 854-7777; Google 'Prairie Knights Casino & Resort' 4.1 from 1,856 reviews (the resort; no separate panel for the casino RV lot); no weekly/monthly/seasonal offer anywhere - long-stay tests do not arise. Tribal-enterprise (Standing Rock Sioux Tribe) ownership kept as private.
